title: StyleSetup
description: Output of the Style Engine. A global StyleSetup is set once per DirectorPlan and inherited by every shot to keep the whole video visually consistent; individual shots may override specific fields.

lut_reference.description: Asset id of a LUT, if applicable.

consistency_seed.description: Shared seed used across shots in the same DirectorPlan to keep subjects/style visually consistent, where the active engine supports seeding.

style_embedding_ref.description: Optional reference to a stored style/character embedding in the vector store, for engines that support it.

reference_image_ids.description: Asset ids of mood-board / reference images.
